remarks: Location! Location! Location! Just steps off desirable Greenwich Avenue sits this amazing state of the art unit. Spacious & flowing, the apartment is surrounded by lg. double hung windows making natural light a prominent first impression. The open floorplan living/dining/kitchen features recessed lighting, wood style floors, 8+ foot ceilings, custom window treatments & architecturally historic fireplace decorative focal point. The custom kitchen offers GE Cafe Appliances, generous workspace, gleaming white quartz counters, breakfast bar & stylish lighting. Each bedroom enjoys an en-suite bathroom, custom storage solutions & room darkening shades. A half bath is accessed from the hallway as well as laundry with full size washer/dryer. Intelligent design, abundant light and great proportions make this unit feel tremendous. 2 reserved parking spaces are included. Enjoy all Greenwich amenities including beaches, parks and more! Walk just blocks to Greenwich Metro North for easy commuting. Endless restaurant and shopping options exist nearby. Must have great credit and references.  A small quiet pet may be considered w/excellent application.
